question: Which mantras are invoked to protect the throat in this armor?
premises: The throat is the body part to be protected
An eighteen-syllabled great mantra is named
A ten-syllabled mantra is also named
inference: The eighteen-syllabled great mantra and the ten-syllabled mantra are invoked to protect the throat.
uncertainties: Whether both protect jointly or sequentially is not explicitly specified
plain_english: May the eighteen-syllabled great mantra and the ten-syllabled mantra protect my throat.
